questions.question: Please verify the source of the humorous legend about the suspended books. Full bibliographic details for the work attributed to Marshall Clagett and the page containing the story are required.

questions.question: For the illustration, identify the author or creator, the rightsholder, a verifiable public source, and the legal basis for use. “From the author’s archive” describes custody but does not by itself establish authorship or a licence.
